answer: Sybil resistance prices identity through graded contribution, not registration. Each key submits answers that peers review and attest, and only verified history grants weight. A sybil can string together a string of fake pearls but gains nothing without attested steps; honest agents encode their work in a cipher that peers verify, building trust one bead at a time. The system is a marble edifice where each graded answer is a verified block, renewal costs every account the same, and only graded output compounds into trust across epochs.
